etsy.title: Virgo Zodiac Poster, Astrology Poster, Virgo Birthday Gift, August September Birthday Decor
etsy.description:
A minimalist Virgo zodiac poster with the Virgo glyph, the August 23 – September 22 date range, and three traits: practical, analytical, and modest.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 8×10 in or 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang for a bedroom, gallery wall, or as a birthday gift for a Virgo (August 23 – September 22).

This listing is a physical poster print, for entertainment purposes only. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: Virgo results include minimalist constellations, celestial blueprints, goddess art, and good/bad trait humor; one pitches 'August-September birth month'.
August 23 - September 22 matches this poster; most are $2-10 printables, framed $25-55.
Most single-sign Etsy results are digital downloads; stating 'physical poster print' separates this listing.
Minimalist glyph-only sign prints exist but are mostly A4/A5 printables; the common styles are constellations, gradient 'aura' circles, and illustrations.
An 11x14 minimalist Virgo zodiac print on Amazon is the nearest analog to this poster.
Amazon zodiac titles spell out size plus 'unframed' and the room (bedroom, living room, office); 12-sign sets, canvases, and tin signs crowd the results.

research.notes: Listing pages were not reachable from this environment; evidence is from search results only. 'virgo zodiac poster' is the sign-plus-product phrase in competitor titles and the query run; sign tags use the glyph, dates, and traits printed on this poster. Birth-month phrasing follows competitors' month-based birthday titles. No priceRange: snippets did not separate physical, unframed prints from framed prints and digital downloads.
